title: MicroservicePrd:CommunitySocial

_meta.purpose: Community Social microservice PRD: visual-social product combining Instagram + Snapchat patterns — photo/video feed, stories, reels, AR effects, close-friends rings, collaborative posts, DM integration — with strict professional/personal dual-context isolation and deep Workflow/Ontology/Foundry ecosystem integration.

identity.ops_surface: managed through OpenTofu-owned infrastructure and root Makefile/oya ops targets; no manual SSH troubleshooting path

crate_ref_bindings.naming_justification: BNF v4.1: oya-<service:community>-<bounded-context:social>-<layer:kernel>; kernel is a canonical ADR-0105 layer suffix and the service/context tokens are registered by ADR-0131.
crate_ref_bindings.port_trait_ownership: owns pure domain types, port traits, and no-I/O invariants for the bounded context
crate_ref_bindings.workflow_ontology_boundary: declares Workflow/Ontology ports for cross-product integration; does not call other product crates

crate_ref_bindings.naming_justification: BNF v4.1: oya-<service:community>-<bounded-context:social>-<layer:domain>; domain is a canonical ADR-0105 layer suffix and the service/context tokens are registered by ADR-0131.
crate_ref_bindings.port_trait_ownership: owns business rules and implements/uses kernel ports without adapter dependencies
crate_ref_bindings.workflow_ontology_boundary: uses kernel ports only; cross-product state is mediated by Workflow/Ontology contracts

crate_ref_bindings.naming_justification: BNF v4.1: oya-<service:community>-<bounded-context:social>-<layer:app>; app is a canonical ADR-0105 layer suffix and the service/context tokens are registered by ADR-0131.
crate_ref_bindings.port_trait_ownership: owns composition/usecase orchestration and wires domain behavior to protocol adapters
crate_ref_bindings.workflow_ontology_boundary: orchestrates Workflow/Ontology adapters at the composition boundary

crate_ref_bindings.naming_justification: BNF v4.1: oya-<service:community>-<bounded-context:social>-<layer:rest>; rest is a canonical ADR-0105 layer suffix and the service/context tokens are registered by ADR-0131.
crate_ref_bindings.port_trait_ownership: owns HTTP route/DTO mapping and calls inward; no domain rules live here
crate_ref_bindings.workflow_ontology_boundary: exposes protocol-specific handlers and delegates inward; direct cross-product calls are forbidden

identity.naming_justification: All planned community-social crates parse as oya-community-social-<layer>; ADR-0056 supplies the BNF discipline and ADR-0105 supplies the canonical layer enum.

acceptance_criteria.given: a user posts a photo in personal context
acceptance_criteria.when: the post is written to storage and indexed
acceptance_criteria.then: context_kind=personal and ownership_pillar=personal are immutable on the artifact; the post does not appear in any professional feed, search index, or Ontology work-graph

acceptance_criteria.given: a user has both personal and work persona grants
acceptance_criteria.then: the social feed, stories ring, close-friends list, and AR camera session are fully reconstructed from the new context; zero cross-context artifact references survive the switch

acceptance_criteria.given: a story is created with ephemeral TTL
acceptance_criteria.then: the story artifact is purged from CDN, search index, and Ontology graph within 60 seconds; a tombstone audit event is emitted

acceptance_criteria.given: a Workflow automation is configured to cross-post a professional story to the Workspace newsfeed
acceptance_criteria.when: the story is published in work context
acceptance_criteria.then: Workflow receives a SocialContentPublished event with explicit consent token; cross-post executes only within professional context; personal context is never consulted

acceptance_criteria.given: an AR effect is applied to a photo
acceptance_criteria.when: the photo is saved or shared
acceptance_criteria.then: effect metadata is stored as a non-sensitive annotation; biometric data derived from face-detection is never persisted beyond the in-session rendering pipeline

acceptance_criteria.given: a collaborative post is created between two users
acceptance_criteria.when: both users are in personal context
acceptance_criteria.then: the collaborative artifact is owned by personal pillar for both users; if either user's context is work, the collaboration requires explicit cross-user consent and is audit logged

out_of_scope.why: ADR-0208 pillar boundary forbids cross-pillar joins; personal and professional feeds are hermetically separate

out_of_scope.item: biometric data persistence from AR effects

dual_context_isolation.mechanism: separate auth realms per context_kind; CommunitySocialFeed, ConnectStoriesRing, ConnectFollowGraph, and CommunitySocialSearchIndex are each pillar-keyed; Cedar policy denies any cross-pillar read or join at the domain layer
dual_context_isolation.follow_graph_isolation: personal follow graph and professional follow graph are separate Ontology sub-graphs; no shared node references
dual_context_isolation.notification_isolation: social notification topics are pillar-prefixed; personal social notifications never route to work notification channels
